title: VitaFit Android application (com.vt.vitafit) before 2.8.1.0 contains a cleartext traffic vulnerability that allows…
description: The VitaFit Android application (com.vt.vitafit) versions prior to 2.8.1.0 have a vulnerability related to cleartext network traffic. This flaw allows attackers on untrusted networks to intercept or modify unencrypted HTTP communications between the app and its server. Specifically, the absence of an Android network security configuration enables manipulation of support content displayed to users by tampering with the HTTP traffic.
